About Boulder Culture

Good things happen
when people show up.

Boulder Culture exists to get people in the same place, in person and for free, so strangers meet, come back, and the culture gets stronger.

Build on what’s here.

People are already opening rooms, making music and bringing neighbors together. Boulder Culture helps people find those events and arrive without needing a group of friends to bring.

Some nights we host. Most nights, at the start, we point to something already happening. The goal is the same: people meet, return and start to know one another.

Starting with existing nights.

Our first listings are Trident’s Monday language exchange and Sunday performances. We credit the organizer and link to the original calendar so you can check the details.

Our own hikes, car meets and yoga gatherings will be announced when a date and place are real. No Boulder Culture-hosted dates are confirmed yet.

The foundation

Boulder Culture Foundation is forming in Colorado and is not yet a 501(c)(3). This site does not accept donations. Boulder Culture is independent of CU Boulder and is not a campus club or political campaign.
